scope: M3 actual Metal native display-resolve stage with immutable two-Float runtime strength/colour parameters; synthetic full1080 inputs and no model in timing benchmark.

candidate.ownership: Each lazy graph owns its immutable two-Float input. Native frame resolve evaluates before returning.
candidate.hostCodeLimitation: Candidate wrapper is compiled in production DLSSMLX; renamed baseline wrapper is compiled in XCTest. Host module/optimization placement differs. Kernel arithmetic is the archived source with names restored for SHA verification.

design.order: Within each group: all eight first-use settings, then the same eight twice. Baseline first iff (setting + repetition) is even; the other arm immediately follows.
design.firstUseMeaning: First encounter of a control pair in this process, not independently cold Metal driver/disk cache. Candidate program is reused after its first call; baseline control values select template variants.
design.timingBoundary: Native MLXVideoFrame resolve call including enqueue, allocation and evaluation completion; excludes CPU readback/hash/comparison and memory snapshot.

fixture.sourceKind: Deterministic synthetic HDR palette and spatial ramp; no model inference or natural-content quality claim

statisticsDefinition.median: middle value or average of middle two
statisticsDefinition.p95: Nearest-rank: sorted values at one-based rank ceil(0.95*n). Matches independent audit definition.
statisticsDefinition.exclusions: None; candidate initial invocation and all outliers retained. Compilation was not separately instrumented.
statisticsDefinition.percentChange: 100*(candidate sum-baseline sum)/baseline sum; negative is lower candidate wall time.

limitations: No new decode, input copy, model settings or source timing; existing single-frame manifests reused.
Eight new views compared separately with old fresh and old continuous outputs:16 complete-byte pairs.
Continuous cut outputs have automatic reset; each new process has cold history, not a temporal-sequence test.
No inference throughput, full playback, temporal-quality, Live or physical HDR acceptance.
Sampled RSS/free disk guardrails are operational cutoffs, not hard transient memory guarantees.
Settings-first-use is not guaranteed cold driver/disk cache; run method alone in a fresh process
Candidate shares a program across settings; its first invocation sample is retained; compilation is not separately instrumented
Wall timing includes native resolve enqueue, output construction and evaluation, not CPU readback or hashing
Readback, comparison, progress publication and synthetic input influence operating conditions outside timed intervals
Timing benchmark excludes inference and complete playback; it makes no Live, physical display or temporal-quality claim
Baseline/candidate host wrappers live in different modules; measured stage change is not exclusively GPU compilation cost.
One short alternating process does not establish sustained player latency, effect-control UI responsiveness, source-rate Live or M5 throughput.
Synthetic reference fixture and real tiny-model regression establish numerical/ownership behavior, not natural-scene temporal quality or physical HDR accuracy.
The initial failed CPU endpoint remains a known baseline discrepancy; final passing exact-parity test does not erase it.
